description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Range touch

Action — remove a Bloom condition from yourself or an ally.

Touch a creature affected by a result from the Bloom Table and end that result's ongoing effect immediately. This cannot restore Vitae wasted by a Rejection result, undo a permanent Runaway Mutation, or reverse a Total Bloom's consequences — those are done.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all.
